data.title: Former Israel Air Force chief: Donald Trump losing military leverage on Iran | The Jerusalem Post
data.description: Speaking to 103FM on Thursday, Maj.-Gen. (res.) Eitan Ben Eliyahu said the Strait of Hormuz talks remained incomplete and warned that regional demands could stretch US air defenses thin.
